title: Past Activities And Messages Open Answer
concept: Past Activities And Messages Japanese composition

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I already ate lunch.
acceptedAnswers: もう昼ご飯を食べました。
questions.explanation: もう + past/affirmative: Say that an expected action has already happened.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: The homework is not finished yet.
acceptedAnswers: 宿題はまだ終わっていません。
questions.explanation: まだ + negative: Say that an expected action has not happened yet.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I am reading the newspaper now.
acceptedAnswers: 今、新聞を読んでいます。
questions.explanation: て-form + います: Describe an action in progress or a continuing state.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I eat after washing my hands.
acceptedAnswers: 手を洗ってから食べます。
questions.explanation: て-form + から: State that one action happens after another is completed.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: On Sundays I read and take walks, among other things.
acceptedAnswers: 日曜日は本を読んだり散歩したりします。
questions.explanation: past plain + り、past plain + りします: List representative activities without claiming a complete list.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I have been to Kyoto.
acceptedAnswers: 京都へ行ったことがあります。
questions.explanation: past plain + ことがあります: Say that someone has experienced an action before.
